chapter.title: PROOFS-a capability plans, execution admission and durable previews

pitfalls.failure: Discovery alone never proves an execution handler. Agent delegation remains an explicit handoff.
pitfalls.recovery: Require the admitted executable handler or report the explicit delegation handoff.

frontier: No live external runtime or hardware proof is claimed by the local catalog workflow.
guidance: Every compiled plan binds its canonical content and final verification stage. Persisted preview phases survive service restart. Approved custom packs reload from scoped storage. Startup uses real local files, production backend dispatch and MCP calls with no eager schemas.

Capability initialization uses an explicit empty vault configuration under disposable proof state. Saved broker/account configurations are never read; these procedures make no vault/account execution claim.

contracts.claim: Compiled plans bind canonical stages and selected capability IDs to their hash, defer schemas, and derive readiness from modeled authority and actual adapter availability.
Every preview mutation persists the exact ordered run record; terminal runs end with a completed result event.
Custom packs require explicit approval, stay inside scoped storage, and reload only valid durable definitions.
Execution reports delegation or approval requirements without synthesizing successful agent work.
Adapter execution support requires a registered real handler; success requires that detected handler.
Built-in inspection size and SHA256 bind the actual selected file bytes.

chapter.title: PROOFS-a receipt-bound capability evolution

pitfalls.failure: Reuse and operator time estimates cannot raise capability trust. Expanded authority and missing review block acceptance.
pitfalls.recovery: Check authority, trust and required review before accepting a capability.

frontier: Startup proves durable receipt semantics using typed finite tool receipts; no live model run, activation or release promotion is claimed.
guidance: Seal exact skill bytes before evidence. Compare unique baseline and candidate receipts, review a regression-free forge, then materialize an inactive package. Bind reusable local app drafts to current proof leases. Renew only with fresh receipt evidence and hold changed dependencies or repair dispositions. Typed app outcomes exclude private text and need recurring friction before suggesting repair.

Capability initialization uses an explicit empty vault configuration under disposable proof state. Saved broker/account configurations are never read; these procedures make no vault/account execution claim.

contracts.claim: Repair thresholds and repeated zero lift select repair/branch with human review; usage alone never raises trust.
Every trial projection retains inactive candidate state and hashes binding sealed Markdown and metadata.
Trial evidence has unique run identities; typed receipt comparisons exclude transcripts and bind derived measurements to the exact sealed package.
Forge scorecards and acceptance gates derive from bounded replay cases; expanded authority blocks acceptance and candidates remain inactive.
Materialization writes scoped inactive sealed bytes; withdrawal retains the package and a digest-bound rollback receipt while projections never activate it.
Only current proof leases permit promotion; current leases retain bound digests and passed dependency signals without activation or transcripts.
App handoffs bind the exact inactive package and a current proof lease to an explicitly reviewed local draft, without activating app or skill.
Only ready typed synthesis becomes idempotent learning evidence without raising trust.

App outcome imports bind sealed receipt digests and typed measurements, count duplicate identities once, separate measured duration from operator estimates, and require recurrent friction before reviewed repair proposals.

chapter.title: PROOFS-a typed tools, authored argv and honest browser replay

pitfalls.failure: Declared contract readiness is distinct from actual executable/version/hash readiness. Replay metrics cannot prove a live change. No unapproved device command may start.
pitfalls.recovery: Validate actual version, hash and authority before starting an executable command.

frontier: Pandoc, LibreOffice, Wasmtime, Syft/Grype and Defender real execution journeys remain unproven because their configured managed installations are absent. Two planned game capability declarations lack catalog ownership.
guidance: Load validated pinned metadata and Word reference bytes. Startup runs actual local Python argv and installed Poppler two-page extraction, checks typed private compatibility projections, rejects unapproved Android/outside-workspace calls before invoking a fixture executor, records approval/heartbeat/disconnect metadata, and executes replay on a separate scratch worker with no NAS fallback. Reviewed renewed guided apps preserve exact inactive lineage through copy/replay/rebind refusal and actual Chromium exports.

Capability initialization uses an explicit empty vault configuration under disposable proof state. Saved broker/account configurations are never read; these procedures make no vault/account execution claim.

contracts.claim: Valid authored tools require approval and exact scoped durable manifests; delegated drafts never imply an available executor.
Actual authored command results preserve scalar argv count, scoped working directory and exit/parse truth; shell characters remain literal input.
Computer Use metrics bind receipt repetition, classified flow success, deterministic agreement, declared URL-source counts, bounded direct latency percentiles and compact receipt bytes.
Persisted replay runs cannot earn live proof or comparative claims and returned receipts match their durable records.
Queued isolated workers carry portable specs/receipts with NAS fallback forbidden and write resulting artifacts beneath the worker root.
Verification requires approval and functional-change claims require passed live evidence; replay cannot earn change or comparison claims.
Typed tool readiness binds healthy verified pins and operations; snapshots keep exact counts and defer operations while execution readiness requires evaluated runtime identity.
Each loaded pinned Pandoc reference binds actual repository bytes to its SHA256 and retains explicit Letter page geometry, one-inch margins, heading/table/compact styles and keep-lines formatting.
Successful tool operations validate input/output schemas and bind their receipt to the pinned package identity.
Chat, secret broker and P2P compatibility projections exclude private token/path/endpoint/ticket fields and explicit exposure flags.
Installed Poppler output preserves its selected PDF source, bounded text size and correct truncation declaration.
Available Android mutation handlers reject unapproved actions before launching any device command.
External session registration/heartbeat/disconnect projections never expose the stored heartbeat verifier hash; session presence does not imply an in-process executor.
Direct marketplace tool paths must remain within the selected active workspace before an executable can be invoked.
Benchmark budget status follows measured p95 and declared budget; ten-times claims require a retained baseline.
A reviewed guided app copies the exact sealed skill/metadata, has no new application permissions, retains inactive digest-bound lineage and a ready durable handoff receipt.
